intent: Restyle the attached 4:3 service-station photograph as a rough two-ink newsprint risograph editorial reproduction while changing only the image-making medium.

inputs.description: The actual base photograph. It owns rider identity, helmet and clothing, pose, hands, motorcycle form, camera, crop, road and station geometry, object placement, exposure structure, and every original visible text mark if any.

style.medium: rough two-ink risograph editorial reproduction on fibrous uncoated newsprint
style.realism: the exact source photograph remains recognizable through limited-ink print behavior
visual_traits: deep charcoal ink and muted rust-red ink only
flat editorial reproduction rather than glossy digital illustration

must_preserve: the rider identity, helmet, clothing, expression visibility, pose, gaze, hands, and exact relationship to the motorcycle
the exact motorcycle identity, geometry, orientation, and placement
the exact camera viewpoint, 4:3 crop, subject scale, and off-center composition
the exact old canopy, pumps, building, road, wet ground, horizon, station geometry, vanishing points, and all object positions
all original visible text exactly if any; where the source has no legible text, introduce none
must_change: only the image-making treatment becomes a rough two-ink charcoal-and-rust risograph reproduction on fibrous newsprint
exclude: new person, vehicle, motorcycle, prop, architecture, sign, logo, letter, number, headline, caption, border, or layout graphic
changed identity, pose, motorcycle, camera, crop, subject position, station geometry, or road perspective
photorealistic wet gloss, oily sheen, excessive bloom, synthetic CGI polish, or post-generation compositing

quality_controls: registration drift stays subtle and never doubles the face, hands, motorcycle edges, canopy supports, or road lines
